title: Salted Edamame in the Pod
summary: Frozen edamame pods boiled briefly and tossed with flaky salt.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Bring the water to a rolling boil and add the frozen pods.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Boil 3-5 min until bright green and the beans are hot all the way through.

steps.title: Drain
steps.text: Drain well and shake off the water.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Toss with the flaky salt and pepper while hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pile into a bowl with an empty bowl alongside for the pods; squeeze the beans out with your teeth.

tips: Do not overcook or the beans turn soft.
Only the beans are eaten, not the pods.
Add a pinch of chilli flakes for heat.
storage: Best hot; keep cooled leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
